pix-0005.rationale: The payer sent 12900 for an 8900 order and asked for the difference back. The difference is above the small-difference threshold and this flow does not refund partial amounts on its own, so a person decides the refund of 4000.

pix-0006.rationale: The customer says the product never arrived but a carrier scan shows delivery; the two contradict each other and the payer already has one dispute, so a person should compare the proof with the customer before any refund.

pix-0007.rationale: A MED dispute is open and there is no delivery proof and no customer message; the payer has a prior chargeback. The store's defense depends on evidence that is not here, so a person must gather it.

pix-0008.rationale: The payout failed because the destination account is closed; retrying to the same account will fail again, so a person must confirm a new destination before any retry.
